title: Frontend runtime harness configs use TypeScript 6-invalid legacy module resolution
actualError: TS5107 moduleResolution=node10 is deprecated and rejected
TS5101 baseUrl is deprecated and rejected
rootCause: Both canonical harness tsconfig files retained the Node alias for node10 resolution and baseUrl-based path mapping while the repository-owned compiler is TypeScript 6.
repairPolicy: Use current Node16 module and resolution contracts and an explicit config-relative paths target; do not suppress deprecations.
sourceFix: Both configs now use module=Node16 and moduleResolution=Node16; baseUrl was removed and the TanStack fixture mapping is explicitly relative to each copied tsconfig.
verification: Actual ADM and Backoffice TypeScript 6 compile plus Node runtime behavior PASS; no deprecation suppression or compiler downgrade is present.
